seo.title: Pricing | Steps AI
seo.description: Start free, then choose the plan that fits how many conversations your AI agent handles. Paid plans include order tracking, human handoff and every channel.

hero.title: Start free, then pay for what your agent does.
hero.body: Every plan includes your AI agent, trained on your own information. Paid plans add your channels, order tracking, human handoff and the tools that turn conversations into sales.
hero.reassurance: Free plan with no time limit. Paid plans include unlimited agents. Cancel at the end of any billing period.

credits.title: How credits work.
credits.intro: A credit is not a reply. The number of credits a reply uses depends on the AI model you choose for your agent.

items.title: Choose the model for each agent
items.body: A lighter model uses fewer credits per reply. A more capable model uses more. You decide per agent.

items.title: See your usage as it happens
items.body: The usage screen shows the credits you have used this month and how many are left.

items.title: Top up with credit packs
items.body: If you run low, buy an extra credit pack instead of changing your plan.

items.title: Credits reset each billing period
items.body: Unused credits do not carry over to the next period, so pick the plan that fits a typical month.

items.q: Is the free plan a trial?
items.a: No. The free plan has no time limit. It does not include channel connections, order tracking or human handoff, which start on Starter.

items.q: Does one credit equal one reply?
items.a: No. Each reply uses a number of credits that depends on the AI model your agent uses. The usage screen shows exactly what you have used.

items.q: What happens if I run out of credits?
items.a: You can buy an extra credit pack or move to a larger plan. Credit packs expire at the end of the billing period.

items.q: Can I cancel at any time?
items.a: Yes. Your plan stays active until the end of the current billing period.

cta.title: Not sure which plan fits?
cta.body: Book a demo and we will look at your message volume with you before you choose.
